macros.name: DeclareFixedFootnote
macros.doc: The package defines only one command, \DeclareFixedFootnote; this declares a footnote to be repeated. Apart from an optional *, it takes two arguments: the command you’ll use to call up the footnote, and the text of each footnote generated.
